Why the database comes first
A row in the embedded database is a blot someone already ran and published. It outranks anything the model can reason its way to, so those rows are placed at the top of the corpus, labelled as the highest priority, and given three votes in the final tally.
What confidence means
The estimated probability that the marker moves in the stated direction — not how sure the model sounds. A clear mechanism can score high with no paper behind it; a paper run at a very different dose or timepoint scores lower than its directness suggests.
What it cannot do
It predicts from published results and signaling logic, never from experiment. Novel compounds are inferred from structural analogues plus a proposed target and carry the most uncertainty. Treat every call as a hypothesis to test at the bench.
